card.name: The 'in' ending of interleukin
card.fires_on: The final 'in' of the split word interleukin when a hyphen and a number follow, as in interleukin-1, -2 or -6. It also fires weakly on other partial words before a hyphen or a name.

modes.label: Interleukin before a number
modes.description: The last piece 'in' of interleukin, right before a hyphen and the number of the interleukin.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Partway through rare names or foreign words that are split into pieces.
modes.example: Frank, kun jij het licht dimmen, z<<od>>at we de presentatie beter kunnen
